# Field Notes Supply

> Field-tested objects for a slower, more considered everyday.

## Pages

- [Home](./): A single-page storefront with a collection of paper goods, kitchenware, and pantry items. Nothing is purchasable: the bag is held in the browser and there is no checkout or payment. Once visited, the page can be added to a home screen and renders without a network.
- [Shop](./#shop): The collection of three products, each with a name, a type, and a price.
- [Our approach](./#story): A short note on choosing fewer, better objects.
